method: WISE W2 2010 vs 2023-24 stacks, detection 5 sigma, epoch-by-epoch track verification (>= 60 % of 23 epochs), proper-motion fit, >= 3 sigma movers, Gaia DR3 + CatWISE2020 cross-match
caveat: A 'candidate' is an unconfirmed moving source that is not in Gaia DR3 or CatWISE2020 with a matching motion. It needs follow-up; it is not a discovery.
